story_type: space shuttle launch from engine start to solid rocket booster separation, tracking and tank cameras
hook: Atlantis throws off two burning boosters at 2,500 mph.
narration: This is the moment a space shuttle threw off its two solid rocket boosters.
Atlantis was carrying six astronauts toward the space station.
Just before the engines start, those sparks burn off loose hydrogen so it cannot build up and explode under the shuttle.
A camera on the fuel tank rode along, looking back at the orbiter's belly.
The main engines throttled down to seventy two percent as it passed through the heaviest air pressure of the climb.
Ninety seconds in, it had already burned half of the four and a half million pounds it lifted off with.
At nineteen miles up and twenty five hundred miles per hour, the boosters burned out.
outcome: Booster separation was confirmed, and Atlantis flew on toward orbit on its three main engines.
title: Shuttle boosters break away at 2,500 mph
description:
Space Shuttle Atlantis lifts off on the STS-132 mission with six astronauts bound for the International Space Station, seen by tracking cameras and a camera on its external tank through solid rocket booster separation.
